title: cyclosorus costularis
intro: Cyclosorus costularis, commonly known as the Chinese quillback or Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and fever, as well as its antiseptic and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus costularis include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Cyclosorus costularis for medicinal purposes.
